content: कटु {%a.%} (टु|ट्वी|{%f.%}) .²1 Pungent, acrid; (said of a {%rasa%} or flavour; the {%rasas%} are six; मधुर, कटु, अम्ल, तिक्त, कषाय, and लवण); कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः . आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकाभयप्रदाः .. <ls>Bg. 17. 9</ls>. .²2 Fragrant, exhaling strong odour; सप्तच्छदक्षीरकटुप्रवाहम् <ls>R. 5. 48</ls>. .²3 Ill-smelling, having a bad smell. .²4 .³({%a%}) Bitter. This sense is found given to the words कटु and कटुक in Prākrit and later sanskrit works; <ab>cf.</ab> अतिकटुः कारवेल्लादिः अतितीक्ष्णो मरिचादिः; अमृततरङ्गिणी on <ls>Bg. 17. 9</ls>, नीलकण्ठ gives the same sense. .²5 caustic (words); <ls>Y. 3. 142</ls>. .³({%b%}) Disagreeable, unpleasant; श्रवणकटु नृपाणामेकवाक्यं विवव्रुः <ls>R. 6. 85</ls>. .²6 Envious. .²7 Hot, impetuous. .{@-टुः@} .²1 Pungency, acerbity (one of the six flavours). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants. .{@-टुः@} {%f.%} A medical plant (कटुरोहिणी). .{@-टु@} {%n.%} .²1 An improper action. .²2 Blaming, reviling, scandal.
